image_description: A brown pelican flying low over a body of water. The bird is captured in profile, moving from left to right. It has dark brown/grey plumage on its body and wings, with a white head and neck. The distinctive long bill with a gular pouch is clearly visible, appearing yellowish-orange. The wings are broad, with the primary feathers separated at the tips (fingered). The legs are tucked back against the tail.
